item.title: When could an Iran peace deal be finalized?
item.description: President Donald Trump called off strikes on Iran, saying a deal to end the war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz, a key trade route, would soon be “finalized.” NBC News' Richard Engel reports from Jerusalem on what could happen next and what Tehran is saying.

item.title: Crude oil futures drop after Trump promises an Iran deal will be signed Friday
item.description: Oil prices had already fallen quite dramatically on Thursday and Friday, in anticipation of an imminent deal. President Trump has posted online that the Strait of Hormuz will reopen after the deal is signed on Friday.

item.title: A Lebanon town's grief in the aftermath of a deadly Israeli airstrike
item.description: More than 3,700 people in Lebanon have died in the war between Israel and Hezbollah. In a village in southern Lebanon, one airstrike last month killed 14 people, including 10 women and children.

item.title: The U.S. and Iran announce a deal to end the war
item.description: President Trump said the U.S. would remove its blockade of the Strait of Hormuz and said a deal will be signed on Friday.

item.title: Trump says U.S.-Iran deal ‘complete’ after months of negotiations
item.description: A deal between the United States and Iran has been reached, President Donald Trump announced Sunday. The President added that the U.S. naval blockade would be removed from the Strait of Hormuz. NBC News’ Keir Simmons has the latest.

item.title: Trump condemns Israeli strike in Beirut, warning attacks threaten deal on U.S-Iran war
item.description: Trump said Israel's attack on Beirut Sunday "should not have happened," but maintained that the U.S. was still "very close to a Deal" to end the war with Iran.

item.title: The U.S.-led war in Iran will dominate Trump's G7 trip to France
item.description: The gathering was originally expected to be a meeting focused on a variety of separate economic and security issues.

item.title: Here’s the biggest news you missed this weekend
item.description: An agreement has been reached between the United States and Iran to end fighting and reopen the Strait of Hormuz, according to President Donald Trump and details of a draft memorandum of understanding released by Iranian state-affiliated media Sunday

item.title: As Iranians wait for a peace agreement, their economy is fraying
item.description: Many Iranians say they can no longer afford the lives they once had. Writer and historian Arash Azizi talks with NPR's Adrian Florido about the economic pressures reshaping daily life.

item.title: Trump travels to France for the 52nd G7 Summit
item.description: President Trump heads to France for the G7 as the war in Iran continues to dominate global discussions.
